title: Topic 20: Animals & Nature - Vocabulary
description: Core words for animals & nature: animal, dog, cat, bird, fish, horse, tree, flower, garden, fly. 8 tap exercises with embedded grammar.
canDoStatement: Talk about pets, common animals and simple nature words
introductionText:
animal = dog, cat, bird...  |  dog = your best friend!
cat = it sleeps all day  |  bird = it can fly and sing
fish = it lives in water (two fish - no -s!)
horse = big, you can ride it  |  tree = big and green
flower = small, beautiful, in the garden
garden = the green place at a house
fly = move in the sky (birds can!)
+ phrase bank: Do you have a pet? | My dog's name
is... | Birds can fly!

vocabularyBlocks.title: Animals & Nature words
exampleSentences: Do you have a pet? (pet = intro-card chunk: an animal in your house)

grammarBlocks.title: Grammar focus
patterns: nothing new - deliberate. The lesson shows
the student how much machine they now own:
has, is, can, does, there are, is sleeping -

questions.question: It lives in water and it can swim - but it can't sing! It is a ___.
Big and green, with birds in it: a ___.
Tap the missing word: Birds can ___ - up, up in the sky!
Tap the missing word: There are red and white flowers in my ___.
Which one is NOT an animal?
A: Do you have a pet? B: ___
options: Yes, I do! I have a small dog
questions.correctAnswer: Yes, I do! I have a small dog

questions.question: Grammar: Birds ___ fly, but they ___ swim like fish!
Grammar: My cat ___ ten years old. She ___ green eyes, and right now she ___ on my bed!

explanations.A1-T20-VOC-Q1: Fish -> water. Bird -> sky and songs!
explanations.A1-T20-VOC-Q2: Tree = big. Flower = small. Garden = the whole green place!
explanations.A1-T20-VOC-Q3: Fly = move in the sky. Fish swim, birds fly!
explanations.A1-T20-VOC-Q4: Garden = the green place at a house (T6 neighbor!).
explanations.A1-T20-VOC-Q5: A flower is nature - but not an animal!
explanations.A1-T20-VOC-Q6: Do you have...? -> Yes, I do / No, I don't (T16 - forever!).
explanations.A1-T20-VOC-Q7: can = yes ability, can't = no ability (T14 + T19).
explanations.A1-T20-VOC-Q8: IS + age (T2), HAS + eyes (T4), IS SLEEPING + now (T17). Three topics, one cat - look how much you know!
